scientific.integrity: The claim separates the symbolic all-orders proof from finite verification and explicitly treats the published complete-multipartite minimum and star polynomial as prior-covered checks.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts.
The finite verifier covers complete multipartite graphs only through order 10; arbitrary order is justified by the symbolic proof.
The closest polynomial paper already gives the scalar complete-multipartite minimum and several special-family polynomials; those consequences are not claimed as new.
Poorly indexed literature under equivalent terminology remains a residual originality risk.

title: Outer-connected domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
